Grant Task Tracker

Theme reference

The tracker reads like a well-kept paper register: sage paper, green-black ink and one council green for actions. Yellow highlighter is kept for what needs attention now, which is keyboard focus and overdue tasks. Nothing else is yellow.

Palette

Paper#EEF1ECPage background
Sheet#FFFFFFPanels, inputs, task list
Ink#1D2B26Text, strong rules, focus ring
Council green#24594AButtons, links, selection, open grants
Highlighter#F5D93BOverdue and focus only
Stamp red#B0302BErrors, rejections, High priority
Muted ink#55665FHints, metadata
Rule#B9C4BDHairlines, quiet borders
Council tint#DCE8E1Selected grant, completed tag
Stamp tint#F6E3E1Unreachable banner

Type

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for everything. It was designed for low-vision readers and keeps 0 and O, 1, l and I apart, which matters when an officer reads GR-100001 or a support reference aloud. Scale is a major third (1.25) from 16px.

49px / 750Sign in
31px / 750Riverside Community Garden Inc.
25px / 750Tasks
20px / 700Verify bank details
16px / 400Body text sits at 16px with 1.5 line height and stays under about 65 characters per line.
13px / 700GR-100001, reference 4bf92f35

Buttons and fields

Press Tab to see focus: an ink ring with a highlighter halo on buttons, and a highlighter stroke that sweeps across a field.

Choose today or a later date.

Status tags

Every tag says its meaning in words, so colour is never the only signal.

Overdue by 10 days Due today Pending Completed 24 Oct Open Closed High priority Medium priority Low priority

Messages

Where an error appears depends on who can fix it. Errors the officer can fix sit next to the field or action that caused them. Errors they can't fix appear as a toast with a support reference. A lost connection shows a banner that stays until a request succeeds.

Banner: server unreachable

Can't reach the server. Changes you make now aren't saved. Check your connection; lists reload when it's back.

Inline: a rule or field the officer can fix

No officer uses this email. Check the spelling, or ask an administrator to add you.

This grant can't be closed yet.

Complete the High priority task "Verify bank details" first.

Toasts: errors the officer can't fix, and confirmations

Couldn't add the task because of a server error.

Try again in a minute. If it keeps failing, give this reference to support.

Tables, filters and dialogs

The grants list and the tasks view use a filter bar above a table. The table scrolls sideways inside its own box on narrow screens. A completed row is tinted and says so in its status tag. Add task opens a native dialog.
